d: Deep in Gujarat, India, stands the Surat Diamond Bourse, the largest office complex on Earth, officially bigger than the US Pentagon. Spanning nine interconnected towers, this architectural giant was built with one clear ambition: to challenge Antwerp’s 500-year-old dominance in the global diamond trade. For half a millennium, Antwerp, Belgium was the undisputed capital of the diamond universe. If a diamond was mined anywhere on Earth, it had to pass through Europe to be certified, priced, and traded. Today, the entire balance of power has shifted.
